faqs.a:
Upon the filing of a petition under the petition method, the council shall proceed
               in the same manner as is provided for hereby where proceedings are initiated by the
               council, except as otherwise expressly provided or necessarily implied in the preceding
               three sections. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the petition is signed by the owner
               of 100 percent of the property to be assessed in the proposed improvement district
               and contains a request for such waiver, the council may, at its discretion, waive
               all or any of the requirements hereof concerning the creation of the proposed improvement
               district, except for the requirements of
sections 78-43
through
78-46
.
(Code 1981, § 27-20; Ord. No. 551, § 10, 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 2294, § 1, 7-7-1986)
